name: omp stats
description: Native Orca sidebar embedding of omp's official telemetry dashboard (http://127.0.0.1:59127). Directly queries ~/.omp/stats.db in read-only mode via an embedded Node SQLite worker (~9ms) to display live KPI sparklines, latency, throughput, token mix, and per-model performance tables.

cover.alt: omp stats telemetry overview and models dashboard

screenshots.alt: omp stats overview with KPI sparklines and activity chart
